name: Shekinah
overview: The Shekinah represents the visible manifestation of God's presence, especially associated with the ark of the testimony in the Holy of Holies. Scripture reveals that God met and communed with His people from above the mercy seat, between the cherubim on the ark (Exodus 25:22), and appeared in a cloud upon the mercy seat (Leviticus 16:2). This divine presence is also described as dwelling between the cherubim, emphasizing God's unique holiness and nearness to His covenant people (2 Samuel 6:2; 2 Kings 19:15; Psalms 80:1). Thus, the Shekinah signifies God's glorious and intimate presence with Israel, centered on the ark in the most holy place.
